'''Miralukese''' was the [[Language/Legends|language]] of the [[Miraluka/Legends|Miraluka]] [[Species/Legends|species]], possessing both spoken and written components. The Miraluka [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] [[Jerec (Inquisitor)|Jerec]] was fluent in both.<ref name="Dark Forces">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20050616a|series=The Dark Forces Saga|text=Part 6: Outcasts and Megalomaniacs Welcome}}</ref>
